title: Anthropic Cut 80% of Its Own Prompt
caption:
I've been adding rules to my CLAUDE.md for months. That was the problem.

Anthropic deleted over 80% of Claude Code's system prompt for the Claude 5 models and their coding evals didn't move. Most of those rules were scaffolding for models that are already gone.

Claude Code just shipped /doctor prompt-audit to find yours. Running it on mine tonight.

What's in yours?

slides.headline:
Anthropic Cut 80%
Of Its Prompt
slides.sub: Claude Code's system prompt, for Claude 5 models. No measurable loss on their coding evals.

slides.title:
The Rules Fought
Each Other
items: System prompt said: "DO NOT add comments"
Another layer said: "leave documentation as appropriate"
Claude spends attention reconciling both before it writes

slides.headline:
39 Words
Became 15
slides.sub: The replacement: "Write code that reads like the surrounding code: match its comment density, naming, and idiom."

slides.title: /doctor prompt-audit
slides.sub: Shipped Sept 25 in v2.1.283. Scans your CLAUDE.md, skills, agents and commands for prompting written for older models.

slides.title:
Rewrite Yours
For Judgement
items: Cut rules the model can infer from your codebase
Drop worked examples — they narrow Claude's exploration space
Spend the tokens on gotchas, not architecture it can read
